provenance.plan: the plan is frozen at commit ea426c4 (approved specification ed3a2ff), internally frozen and not externally preregistered

code.tree_clean_means: git status --porcelain -- pipeline tests PREANALYSIS.md, run in the gizmo folder, printed nothing (untracked files included), so the commit is the code that ran
code.code_identity_means: git rev-parse --verify HEAD:./<path>, run in the gizmo folder, for pipeline, tests and PREANALYSIS.md: the git tree id of pipeline and of tests and the blob id of the plan at the commit. An id depends only on the content under its path, so with tree_clean true the three ids are the code and the plan that ran, whatever else the repository's commit holds. A resumed run is refused unless all three equal the manifest's (Joe, 2026-11-20, D-122: "Compare code identity"); the commit is recorded and not compared

provenance.outcome_file_hash_in_words: frame_fingerprint of the outcome file as the reader returned it, from the door's record
provenance.assembled_inputs_record_fingerprint_mean: sha256 of the assembler's record converted by the writer's rule, with clock readings left out (_seconds_by_source, assembled_at_utc, read_at_utc, seconds, time_utc, written_at_utc); None when no assembler record was given
provenance.order_enforcement: run_outcomes.run and run_outcomes.run_all are not changed and do not check the order; the coordinator in pipeline/analysis/execute_outcomes.py is where the order is enforced

body.plan_section: Conditions tested (four), 4: past utilization above against at or below the median
body.builder: design.build_with_rules under the headline rules, conditions.past_utilization_grouping
labels: descriptive and exploratory: no range, no test, no significance stars; the headline procedure's validation is not transferred to it; one group's estimate beside the other's is not evidence that the two differ, and only the difference is described
companion set: the agent's reading: the plan does not settle this

headline_set at 2%.validation: not applicable: a descriptive contrast with no range and no test, so no validation is claimed (None is kept for the validated headline alone)
headline_set at 2%.label: descriptive and exploratory: no range, no test, no significance stars; the headline procedure's validation is not transferred to it; one group's estimate beside the other's is not evidence that the two differ, and only the difference is described

contrast.rule: peak demand in the reference year over the largest peak reported in any earlier year from 2001 (peak = the larger of summer and winter); used only where the utility's footprint is shown comparable over 2001 to the reference year by tests (i) one state, (ii) no succession inside the history and (iii) customer continuity; first group if strictly above the median among the classifiable hosts in the estimate; lines 1 to 6 read the plan's one-line definition (coordinator's instruction of 2026-11-19), adopted by Joe on 2026-11-19 (D-111); line 7 (EIA-imputed rows are no report) is the agent's reading; the three footprint tests read 'comparable utility footprints' in the owner's ruling of 2026-11-19, adopted by Joe on 2026-11-19 (D-111); the 10% line in test (iii) is a convention fixed by the session before any customer series was examined for this purpose
contrast.label: measures how hard the system had been used; not a measure of spare generation or network capacity
contrast.difference_is: past utilization above the median minus past utilization at or below the median
contrast.what_this_is: descriptive and exploratory: no range, no test, no significance stars; the headline procedure's validation is not transferred to it; one group's estimate beside the other's is not evidence that the two differ, and only the difference is described
contrast.estimable_means: passing the rank test establishes computational estimability only
